name: arare
description: Arare - a stack-based, vector-oriented language that quantizes by design and accounts for the precision it gives up

scripts.build:web: npm run build:engine && ARARE_BUILD_TARGET=web vite build
scripts.build:tauri-frontend: npm run build:engine && ARARE_BUILD_TARGET=tauri vite build
scripts.vendor:katex: rm -rf public/vendor/katex && mkdir -p public/vendor/katex/contrib public/vendor/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js public/vendor/katex/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js public/vendor/katex/contrib/ && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 public/vendor/katex/fonts/ && cp node_modules/katex/LICENSE public/vendor/katex/LICENSE && node scripts/vendor-katex-banner.mjs
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.check:formal: cd formal && lake build && cd .. && node scripts/check-formal-axioms.mjs
scripts.check:gates: npm run check:requirements && npm run check:traceability && npm run check:version-sync && npm run check:file-size && npm run check:contrast
scripts.check:requirements: node scripts/check-requirements.mjs && node scripts/generate-requirements.mjs --check && node scripts/generate-word-reference.mjs --check
scripts.check:oracle: cargo build --quiet --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p arare-cli && node scripts/check-oracle.mjs
scripts.check:oracle-random: cargo build --quiet --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p arare-cli && node scripts/check-oracle-random.mjs
